Method of Attack: Encrypts local files using XOR encryption
Steals credentials for multiple Chinese online services
Displays ransom screen demanding 110 yuan via WeChat QR code
Uses Chinese social networking service Douban to send commands
Propagated through compromised popular application managing multiple QQ accounts
Poisoned at least 50 applications to spread ransomware
Impacted Systems: Chinese online services including Taobao, Alipay, Tmall, Aliwangwang, 163 Mailbox, Baidu Cloud, Jingdong, QQ
Attack Vector: Compromised popular QQ account management application
Command and control via Douban platform
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom payment via Tencent's WeChat QR code
Over 20,000 stolen passwords found on malware servers
Douban page used as command and control server (deleted)
WeChat QR code account banned by Tencent
